primaryText: Mary read some of the books.

readings.name: Mary read at least some of the books.
Mary read some, but not all, of the books.

comment: The global scalar implicature: the literal (1a) and the upper-bounded (1b) interpretations.

primaryText: Every student read some of the books.

readings.name: Not every student read all of the books.
No student read all of the books.

comment: The weak inference (2a) is the global implicature; the strong inference (2b) is the embedded one, which no alternative of an unmodified neo-Gricean account generates.

primaryText: Some students read all of the books.
comment: The alternative to (2) obtained by replacing both scalar terms (Sauerland 2004); it does not entail (2), and its negation is the strong inference (2b).

readings.name: The soup is warm, but not hot.

comment: A scale whose global implicature arises at a lower rate than some/all (van Tiel et al. 2016).
